title: Nourishing Smoky Spanish Chorizo Paella
description: A resinous, chewy, comforting Spanish dish featuring chorizo, jamon iberico, and a savory smokiness.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a tagine pot over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced chorizo and cook until browned, about 2 minutes.
Remove the chorizo from the pot and set aside.
Add the remaining olive oil to the pot and cook the chopped onion until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the saffron threads and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced jamón ibérico and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the low-sodium chicken broth, filtered water, smoked tomatoes, green olives, red pepper flakes, capers, and chopped fresh parsley to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a boil.
Add the browned chorizo back to the pot and stir to combine.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer to the oven to bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25-30 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, grated orange zest, and toasted sesame seeds.
